effect: A 10th panel, 200 gold, that the shop never sells, no round gives, and that does nothing when equipped
note: The panel tables have 10 entries: names $00:301F (ELIXER ... FIREPASS, HATISUKE), prices $00:1CEC (HATISUKE 200) and unlock masks $00:335B. The BUY cursor wraps after 9 ($00:2E18), HATISUKE's unlock mask is 0, so it would read ??? anyway, and the round pickups' jump table ($01:49D4) points at the stubs for panels 0-8 but not at the one for panel 9 ($01:4A44, Bomber Boy $01:4A29). SELL and Panel Select do step through 10 slots. No round code checks for it: $00:0827 counts panels 1-3 and flags 4-8, and ELIXER (0) is used on death; after a round $00:0924 removes it like the other one-round panels. Put in the inventory ($C4C0 = 9) and equipped in Mesen, the round started with the same bombs, fire, speed and flags as with nothing. Images: drawn in the shop by pointing the lookups at slot 9 (Atomic Punk, Bomber Boy), and equipped on Panel Select (the ? icon).

effect: Every island clear writes a CONTINUE password to the screen map, never shown
note: After an island's last round the game plays the rescue scene ($00:3CB9, THANK YOU! KID!). Before it (not on Faria), it adds the owned panels' prices to the gold as game over does, runs the password encoder ($01:4650, JP $01:4635) into the screen map at $9C0A, and puts the gold back. That map is never displayed (the window is off and the palette blank) and is wiped before the next screen, so only game over ever shows a password. Read from VRAM in Mesen after clearing Jagoraz with 300 gold and 600 in panels: 6L1PLRCW (Atomic Punk) and 6J1MJOBS (Bomber Boy), which decode to Jagoraz cleared, 900 gold.

effect: A tune only the hidden sound test plays, and ten effects nothing plays
note: Music goes through $0475 and effects through $0480 (and $1931). No request gives tune 04 (the island table at $02B8 covers 0B-13); only the stage-select sound test plays it, a full tune. That test plays music only, so effects 02, 06, 07, 0C, 0E, 11 and 16-19 can't be heard at all. 02 is a held tone; the rest last 0.1 to 0.9 s, 06/07 and 0C/0E being pairs at different pitches.
